title: ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
⊙ Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety No. 628 (July 1, 2026)

Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety on Partial Amendments to 22 Statutes under the Jurisdiction of the National Fire Agency Following the Establishment of Integrated Special Cities

Articles 1 through 14 Omitted

Article 15 (Amendment to the Enforcement Rule of the Act on Management of Firefighting Equipment) The Enforcement Rule of the Act on Management of Firefighting Equipment is partially amended as follows.
In Article 2, subparagraph 6, “Metropolitan City” is replaced with “Integrated Special City or Metropolitan City”.
In the former part of Article 20-2 (1), “Metropolitan City Mayor” is replaced with “Integrated Special City Mayor or Metropolitan City Mayor”.

Articles 16 through 22 Omitted

Addenda

This Rule shall enter into force on July 1, 2026.

[Batch Amendment]

◇ Reasons for Amendment and Main Provisions

The Special Act on the Establishment of Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City has been enacted (Act No. 21446, promulgated on March 5, 2026, effective July 1, 2026), providing, among other matters, for the abolition of the former Jeollanam-do and Gwangju Metropolitan City, the establishment of Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City, and two deputy heads at the integrated special city's fire headquarters. Accordingly, integrated special cities and their mayors are reflected in provisions concerning local governments and their heads in Ordinances of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety under the jurisdiction of the National Fire Agency. In addition, the deputy head and the head of the fire headquarters will serve, respectively, as the first and second performance evaluators for fire officials of an integrated special city holding the rank of fire chief (Sobangjeong). These changes amend 22 Ordinances of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety under the jurisdiction of the National Fire Agency, including the Enforcement Rule of the Act on 119 Rescue and Emergency Medical Services.

<Provided by the Ministry of the Interior and Safety>
